notes_for_editor: The FFLA county and statewide lists agree the Pine Mountain tower is gone, so the brief's status holds and no correction is proposed. Only the FFLA entry names a tower on this summit; two searches and the TopoQuest and Wikipedia pages describe the summit or the nearby Lima Mountain tower but no tower on Pine Mountain. The FFLA point and TopoQuest's summit coordinates are close, so the entry most likely refers to that summit, but this is an inference, not a source statement. Lima Mountain, a few kilometres west, is a separate listed tower; do not merge the two. The story is 102 words, below the 120-word guide floor, because no other source was found. The FFLA's asterisk note ('Standing*') appears on other Cook County towers, not this one.
